programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Mega - Spartak
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season.
